text: __NOTOC__ Merill Pleasance is a Forsaken tabard vendor located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. She was present during the Battle for Lordaeron and could be evacuated out of the Undercity.

The Merchant Coast is the name given to the small portion of the Northern Barrens that forms the coastline of the Great Sea. Along the Merchant Coast is the goblin port town of Ratchet, and the Theramore outpost, Northwatch Hold. Off the coast is Fray Island. The Merchant Coast receives its name from the lucrative trade that takes place through the thrifty hands of the Ratchet goblins. For years, the southern portion of the Merchant Coast was controlled by the Southsea Freebooters. Following the Shattering they left the area, allowing the Alliance's Northwatch Expeditionary Unit, led by Rear Admiral Hartley, to take over. Much to Gazlowe's dismay, the Northwatch forces have been interrupting

Mephits are clawed elemental flying creatures hailing from the Elemental Plane and the Twisting Nether. On the elemental plane mephits and lesser elementals share a position of power just above elemental sprites, but are below all other denizens of the planes. Mephits are tolerated only because they amuse the Elemental Lords or because the Lord in question sees fit to keep them around, to Al'Akir they are akin to pets, while Therazane treats hers as her cherished children. Mephits fight in mobs, which is often the case when encountered in the Twisting Nether. The mobs may be made up of various types. Some can be found on Azeroth such as a Dark Iron cave in the Badlands.

The Merchant Square is the northeastern section of Gilneas City. It is a market area that connects to the Military District to the south, and the Livery Outpost to the northeast. It is here where new worgen players start. After the area is overrun by feral worgen, civilians evacuate to the Military District. The Battle for Gilneas City begins here, from the staging area at the Livery Outpost.
Mesmerize is a Shivarra ability. It is the equivalent of the Succubus' Seduction ability.

__NOTOC__ Merhean Sunfall is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern. Merhean, Seleria Dawncaller and Lan'veros Furybrand have traveled to the Dranosh'ar Blockade bringing Light-infused Sun Spheres from Silvermoon City for the Horde champions shipping off to the Broken Shore.
The Metal Fans are Forsaken fans of the Blight Boar band located on the Darkmoon Island.

Micah Broadhoof is a Highmountain tauren located in the Twilight Vineyards in Suramar City during the vulpera recruitment questline. Along with Boss Mida and Nomi, he was sent to assist in producing arcwine for the Horde. Vintner Iltheux put him in charge of creating a recipe for the wine, a task he's ill-suited for. When Meerah and the Horde adventurer arrive at the vineyards to help with production, they reassign Micah to the more suitable role of stomping fruit. He can subsequently be seen performing this task, even after Nomi somehow sets the vat on fire.

Mi'kai, As Argus, the Unmaker is a performance of Argus the Unmaker by Mi'kai, a vorkai actor, at the Star Lake Amphitheater in Ardenweald. She can be seen during the Night Fae-only quest Break a Leg. She's also one of several rare mobs that can be summoned by using the Night Fae Covenant's Anima Conductor to channel anima to Dreamsong Fenn, then speaking to Dapperdew at the Star Lake Amphitheater. Characters of any covenant can help defeat her once she's been summoned.

The Military Ward of Ironforge is a district that serves as the command center and base of the Ironforge military, as well as the focal point for most martial functions within the city. Central to the Military Ward is the Hall of Arms, which houses hunter and warrior trainers, battlemasters, and a hangar for both steam tanks and dwarven flying machines. Several supply shops and similar establishments can also be found scattered throughout the district.
Millie Gregorian is a Forsaken tailoring vendor located in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity.

Millhouse "Jerimus" Manastorm is a wily gnome mage that first appeared as a prisoner trapped in the Arcatraz wing of Tempest Keep. In order to acquire The Tempest Key, formerly required to unlock The Eye wing of Tempest Keep, players must enter Arcatraz on heroic mode, and make sure that Millhouse survives until the death of . He is released during the second wave of the Harbinger Skyriss encounter in the Arcatraz. His rescue was also required part of Trial of the Naaru: Tenacity. Later on, Manastorm appeared scheming with the Twilight's Hammer in Deepholm and yet later in the Brawler's Guild in Stormwind City and Orgrimmar as an opponent. If the player upgrades an inn to Level 2 at their Ti
Mindless Undead appear in Slaughter Square in Stratholme after Ramstein the Gorger is slain. Despite their large numbers, they can be easily destroyed by aoe abilities.

Mindgames is the priest class ability of the Venthyr Covenant. It's available to all priests who join the Venthyr. This ability is also temporarily available during the Revendreth portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Authority of Revendreth and lasts until you finish the Revendreth storyline.

Mirkfallon Lake is a lake located within the center of Stonetalon Mountains. It was once host to a wide variety of creatures, including wyverns, slimes, and thunder lizards. Since the Cataclysm the lake has been taken over by the Bilgewater Cartel, who have constructed the goblin-run Sludgewerks. The goblins have carved out the hill in the center of the lake, replacing it with an oil platform, and pumpjacks surround the area. Several paths cross through this area: Stonetalon Peak and Cliffwalker Post are north, Dagger Pass to the west leads to Battlescar Valley, Webwinder Path is south, and a mountain path to the east leads to Windshear Hold and Windshear Crag. Above the lake is Windshear He
Minor Magic Resistance Potion is a potion that gives a small increase to resist all types of magic.

__NOTOC__ .]] Mishi is a cloud serpent companion of Lorewalker Cho who flies Cho's adventurer friend around Pandaria when needed. Despite usually being small, Mishi has the ability to grow into a full-sized cloud serpent mount. This seems to be a unique ability to her alone. She is found in phased quest areas, and also in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms at each Shrine.
Mirror Image was an ability granted to Balance Druids when they cast Symbiosis on a Mage. It was a version of the Mage ability Mirror Image.

__NOTOC__ Mirabelle is a worgen located in the Undercity during the Battle for Lordaeron. She and Renzik infiltrated the city and retreated when the Horde forces led by Varok Saurfang discovered them.
The Miniature Flying Carpet was crafted with Tailoring; Taught by Pattern: Miniature Flying Carpet. It was never made available, and was replaced by the Elekk Plushie before launch.

Mirrors of Torment is the mage class ability of the Venthyr Covenant. It's available to all mages who join the Venthyr. This ability is also temporarily available during the Revendreth portion of the Shadowlands campaign; it's given by the quest The Authority of Revendreth and lasts until you finish the Revendreth storyline.
Mismatched Mail Gloves drop from Shattered Hand Bonechoppers and Shattered Hand Torturers in Tanaan Jungle.
Mismatched Cloth Gloves drop from Shattered Hand Bonechoppers and Shattered Hand Torturer in Tanaan Jungle.
Mismatched Plate Gauntlets drop from Shattered Hand Torturers and Shattered Hand Bonechoppers in Tanaan Jungle.
Mismatched Leather Gloves drop from Shattered Hand Bonechoppers and Shattered Hand Torturers in Tanaan Jungle.

__NOTOC__ Mister Knuckles is an ogre located next to Madam Goya in the Black Market Auction House in the in . He acts as one of her bodyguards. Years later, Knuckles participated in a corn dog eating contest on Darkmoon Island on Azeroth.

Mistress Matilda is an apparent Forsaken located at the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity. She is organizing a party in Undercity. In truth, she is a homunculus created by the Burning Legion to infiltrate their enemies.

Misty Pine Refuge is an outpost building of the Argent Dawn. It is located in central Dun Morogh, and currently houses only one agent of the organization, Father Gavin. Several refugees are waiting here, helped by Buin "Phloppy" Freehand, a generous volunteer. A Broken and Wildhammer dwarf have been sent here to learn about what the Cataclysm brought to the region. During the Legion Invasions, the area was invaded by the demons, but defended by Mountaineer Helmholt, his mountaineers, guards, and adventurers.
Moaoto is a Broken found in Lower City in Shattrath City. This pig farmer will give players, who attended the Blizzard Worldwide Invitational 2007 and provide a code, a Fortune Coin.

The Mjordin are a group of vrykul from Jotunheim. Little is known about them, but they are mentioned in a way that makes them seem a major force. Indeed, had King Ymiron blown the horns and called for all of the leaders of the ymirjar and mjordin alike, the vrykul would've become a force more powerful than any other within the Scourge. This action would've organized the vrykul nation. The exact relation between the Mjordin and the Jotunheim vrykul is unclear. They share the cliff city of Jotunheim and the Balargarde Fortress but there was no evidence to link them directly.

Mobile Banking is a guild perk active ability that allows temporary guild bank access at any location. Guild members present may use the summoned "Guild Chest" unless they still have neutral guild reputation, preventing newcomers from taking immediate advantage but allowing most members to use it. Access to the chest is not restricted by the ability's one hour cooldown, so it is possible to use another guild member's chest after the first one expires.

__NOTOC__ The Moat Monster is a creature that lives in a slime moat in the Ruins of Lordaeron above the Undercity. The Forsaken regularly feed it, and use feeding days to train it to attack Alliance members. Eunice Burch implies that the Forsaken intended the monster to replace the Kor'kron overseers in guarding the Undercity. In order to produce food for the Moat Monster, the Forsaken first fatten up flies with dead meat from meat wagons. They then feed the flies to their spiders, which they then feed to frogs, which they finally feed to the monster. It's unknown exactly what the monster is, since it only reveals a single green tentacle when fed.

World of Warcraft®: Mists of Pandaria™ BlizzCon 2011 FAQ ;What is the story of World of Warcraft®: Mists of Pandaria™? :Alliance warships prowl the seas. Horde armies thunder across Kalimdor. Tensions between these factions edge closer to erupting in a savage war that threatens to consume all of Azeroth. Against this backdrop of impending conflict, an uncharted island mysteriously appears.... :Shrouded in fog since the world was sundered more than ten thousand years ago, the ancient realm of Pandaria has remained unspoiled by war. Its lush forests and cloud-ringed mountains are home to a complex ecosystem of indigenous races and exotic creatures -- including the enigmatic pandaren. :All

Mo'ruk is a grand master Pet Tamer located on the island of Narsong Spires of the southern coast of Krasarang Wilds in Pandaria. He is surrounded by his three level 25 battle pets: Needleback (aquatic), Woodcarver (beast), and Lightstalker (flying). Defeating him is required to complete the Taming Pandaria achievement.

Mistvale is a large area in northeastern Val'sharah containing Ashamane's Fall and Ashamane's Gate. It is a very marshy but lush land due to Highmountain's snow melt flowing into it. Luckily, the Emerald Nightmare has not yet this incurred this innocent land, but hostile bears are still a threat to the common traveler. A road runs through it that takes you to Sylvan Vale, and the Emerald Ascent a path that climbs Highmountain.

The Mnemonic Locus is located in eastern Bastion. It is where Bastion collects the memories of all kyrian and was designed by the First Forgelite. These memories include recollections of particular moments in a kyrian's journey on the way to ascension. The First Forgelite built the Locus with the ability to view and extract memories through soul mirrors powered by anima. While the extract is in the Locus proper, the mirrors are in the Walk of Recollection which contains both the Vault of Memory and the Vault of the Archon. It is maintained by the Locus-Keeper Mnemis.

Mizzen is a goblin standing next to the Warcraft Rumble Machine in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar, in Stormwind Harbor of Stormwind City, and on the second floor of the Roasted Ram in Valdrakken.

The Molten Core is a level 60 raid dungeon located within Blackrock Mountain, home and seat of power to Ragnaros the Firelord. It was one of two forty (40) player raid dungeons available upon release of World of Warcraft, the other being Onyxia's Lair. Considered the pinnacle of raiding achievement at the time, the Molten Core enticed adventurers to enter the instance in the search of realm glory. The sulfuric Molten Core is a gateway from the Firelands to Azeroth.

Mojo the Twisted is a rare mob ogre that can be found in the Blasted Lands. He has a buff Fel Armor, which Increase spell power by 10%. Also regenerates 2% of maximum health every 5 sec. Drops Imperfect Draenethyst Fragment

Mok'Doom is an area of Lower Blackrock Spire, and the domain of the Spirestone ogres. It is ruled by Highlord Omokk, who has been granted a boon by Urok Doomhowl. This boon ensures that any ogre who challenges Omokk is struck dead by magic. Thus, only a non-ogre could kill Omokk. Mok'Doom itself is a dead-end area that is reached by a short stone bridge leading from the upper reaches of Hordemar City.

Mogu'shan Terrace overlooks Zouchin Province in northeast Kun-Lai Summit. It serves as the entrance to the Mogu'shan Vaults raid instance and is only accessible via flying mount or some creative mountaineering down from the Peak of Serenity. Later in the raid, adventurers reach The Emperor's Reach, which is accessible just to the northwest in the open world as well. The monk lore object Victory in Kun-Lai is on the lower level of the terrace. Interacting with the object is one of the objectives of the Pandaria exploration achievement What Is Worth Fighting For.

Moonbrook is a small town located southwest of Sentinel Hill, which once served as a mining town and the focal point of the farmlands in Westfall. After being razed by the orcs during the First War, then rebuilt following the Second War, the rampant corruption in the kingdom brought the town under the control of the Defias Brotherhood. Without the Stormwind Army to protect them, the Defias drove out the citizens and used the Deadmines as their headquarters. After years of tyranny, the People's militia and the adventurers liberated Moonbrook after they killed the Brotherhood's leader, Edwin VanCleef. However, the war against the Lich King caused a financial crisis in the kingdom, and a high p
Mooncloth Bag is a 16 slot bag made from Mooncloth. It ties with the Traveler's Backpack as the largest bag that does not bind (either when picked up or when used).
wearing a Mooncloth Robe (before patch 4.3.0)]] .]] Mooncloth Robe is a chest piece especially made for Discipline and Holy priests.

The Monoliths were rune-inlaid stones in Ashenvale which warped the forest creatures into destructive, feral monsters in the official Blizzard scenario map for Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne called "Monolith". The forest beings who were warped included dark trolls, satyrs, furbolgs, forest trolls, spiders, wolves and skinks. These forest creatures were powered by the monoliths and monolith shards which were both destroyed by the forces of humans, orcs, undead and night elves.

The building is located in Moonbrook around southern Westfall and looks somewhat like a town hall. There is a cemetery behind it. It is the building in north-westernmost Moonbrook. In the quest The Legend of Stalvan, one is sent to the schoolhouse to find a letter in a footlocker that appears in the main room of the ground floor, just short of the elevated part.

Moon Over the Vale is an ancient tablet that speaks of the bravery of the trolls of Gurubashi defending their homeland under the moonlight in Stranglethorn Vale. The tablet is located in the Bal'lal Ruins, almost directly north of the Horde camp, Grom'gol Base Camp, and southwest of the hunter's camp where Hemet Nesingwary Jr. can be found. The tablet is in the northwest corner of the ruins. The Alliance has recently expressed interest in this particular legend. Brother Nimetz of the Rebel Camp in Stranglethorn Vale is sending adventurers to investigate many troll legends in the area in hopes of finding answers regarding Colonel Kurzen's corruption, and this is one on his list (see Kurzen's

Moongraze Buck Hides drop from Moongraze Bucks in Azuremyst Isle.
The Moon Robes of Elune are a quest reward Garments of the Moon.
Moongraze Fur Cloak is a quest reward from The Great Moongraze Hunt (2).
Moongraze Hide Boots are a quest reward from The Great Moongraze Hunt (2).

The Monument to the Fallen is a landmark located just outside the Sun's Reach Sanctum on the Isle of Quel'Danas. Its completion opens up Phase 4B of the Shattered Sun Offensive. The monument is a double-sided statue showing a draenei (representing the Aldor) and a blood elf (representing the Scryers). This is to symbolize the alliance between the two opposing factions - which culminated in the Shattered Sun Offensive - against Kael'thas Sunstrider's nefarious scheme on the Sunwell Isle, and also to memorialize the Aldor and Scryer dead who fought Kael'thas and the Legion to reclaim Sun's Reach. The monument took on an additional meaning to the wider blood elf race, as Quel'Danas was also the
A Moonglow Cuttlefish School is a Fishing pool which primarily contains Moonglow Cuttlefish. These schools can be found in the Frozen Sea around Northrend.

Moonkin Hatchling is found inside a Moonkin Egg, which is available from the shop or the In-Game Store for $10 or €10. It was released on November 29, 2010 along with Lil' Ragnaros. With the See You Later Bundle on 20 December 2018, this pet was available at a discounted price with other items. The pet is no longer available for purchase as it entered hibernation in the Blizzard Archive as of 19 January 2019.

Moonkin Egg was available from the shop or the In-Game Store for $10 or €10. It was released on November 29, 2010 along with Lil' Ragnaros. Opening it will give you a Moonkin Hatchling for your faction. With the See You Later Bundle on 20 December 2018, this pet was available at a discounted price with other items. They are no longer available for purchase as it entered hibernation in the Blizzard Archive as of 19 January 2019.

Monk quests becomes available at level 11 when monks learn Zen Pilgrimage to teleport to Peak of Serenity. After starting the storyline, the original Peak of Serenity monastery is destroyed - to access it and the quests, players need to speak with Zidormi.

Moonglade Wardens are max level night elf and tauren guards located throughout Moonglade. While normally friendly to both factions, they will turn hostile towards any player that engages any friendly NPC's or other players (if the victim has at least a Friendly standing with the Cenarion Circle) of the opposing faction.
Moonfang Packmates are level 102 wolves that are occasionally summoned by Moonfang during her encounter. For every enemy within 40 yards of her a packmate will appear.
Moonalli is a tauren fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. He died after the portal was destroyed.

Moonbrook Thugs are Vanessa VanCleef's minions, found armed with broken bottles and loitering around the town of Moonbrook in Westfall. When they arrived, they began handing out propaganda pamphlets to the local homeless, inciting them to violence. They also carry Red Bandanas, hinting at their affiliation with the newly reborn Defias Brotherhood.
The Moonglade Gatewardens are dryads found at the gate to Moonglade in the Emerald Dreamway.
Moon Guard Stronghold is a large fortress in northern Suramar. The Moon Guard there have been recently killed by the nightborne armed forces.
Moonfall Approach is a path leading from the Feathermane Hunting Grounds of Suramar into the Lower Gardens of Moon Guard Stronghold.
Moonfall Overlook is an area in the Moon Guard Stronghold of Suramar.
Moonfall Roost is the nesting grounds for hippogryphs in the Moon Guard Stronghold of Suramar.
Moon and Stars is a Balance druid PvP talent, available at level 40.
Moonkin Stones were found scattered around the area at the Stormrage Barrow Dens in Moonglade.
__NOTOC__ Moonclaw Druids are night elves located in Moonclaw Vale in Val'sharah.
Moonfeather Handwraps drops from Lyrath Moonfeather in Shala'nir in Val'sharah.
Moof is a Highmountain tauren located in Island Expeditions.
Mooncaller Mozo'kas is a Zandalari troll located in the Port of Zandalar in Dazar'alor. She and her Raptari team participate in Island Expeditions.
Moonchaser the Swift is a stag located in Island Expeditions.
Moonfall Acolytes are night elves located at Moon Guard Stronghold in Suramar.
Moon-Spirit Essence is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Moon-Touched Huntress is a nightsaber located in Island Expeditions.
Moonfall Defenders are night elves located at Moon Guard Stronghold in Suramar.
Moon-Touched Netherwhelp is a special nether whelp companion for Blizzard Entertainment's 30th anniversary. Obtaining this pet rewards the Netherwhelp Online feat of strength.
Moonfire Stranglers drop from the Sisters of the Moon in the Tomb of Sargeras.
Moongraze Linked Boots are a quest reward from The Great Moongraze Hunt (2).
Moon-Blessed Claw is obtained by using the Coalesced Moonlight at the Feral Dreamstone in the Emerald Dream.

Morgan's Vigil is an Alliance settlement in the southeastern corner of the Burning Steppes. It is only a small village left in ruins; with houses and structures burned to the ground and a single mage tower left crumbled and destroyed. Several tents have been erected for the inhabitants to live in. Although once used as an outpost for adventurers, it has now been all but abandoned. Several of the previous residents, along with the town's namesake Morgan herself, have gone to the depths of Blackrock Mountain to better stop the nefarious activities there.
Morley Bates is a Forsaken fungus and drink vendor located in the Magic Quarter in the Undercity.
Moonstalker Runts are saber cats found in Darkshore. They are the companions of Moonstalker Matriarchs.

Moonwing Den is a series of small moonkin camps that are located on Silvermyst Isle. The owlbeasts are now very aggressive from crystal radiation and a lot of caution should be excercised when exploring the nearby area. A wicker effigy dedicated to the fire elemental Hauteur can be found here.

Morbent's Bane is a off-hand item. Sven Yorgen sends adventurers to forge a weapon capable of defeating Morbent Fel. Lightforge Ingots salvaged from the sunken elven destroyer, the Flying Osprey, are used in its creation. The Torch of Holy Flame is the quest reward version of this item.

Morgroron is one of two massive pit lords found at Legion Hold in Shadowmoon Valley. He and his companion, Makazradon, wield weapons crafted with powerful anti-demon enchantments intended for use against Illidan.
The Moonwell Water Tube is obtained by filling the Empty Water Tube at the Moonwell in Auberdine.
The Moonstone Altar is located in Azshara. It holds the scared Southfury Moonstone.
__NOTOC__ Moonrest Stalkers are darkhounds found in Moonrest Gardens in the Dragonblight.
Moonrest Highborne is a wraith located in the Moonrest Gardens in the Dragonblight.

Morbidus is a level 80 elite flesh giant located at the Fleshwerks in the Icecrown. According to Darkrider Arly, he is the Fleshwerks' greatest accomplishment. The player is sent to talk to Margrave Dhakar to start the encounter, after which the Lich King teleports in, taunting the player before teleporting back out. Crusader Olakin Sainrith spawns after this and the combined forces slay Morbidus.
Moonsteel Ingots can be found inside the object Moonsteel Ingots in Shadowfang Keep during the related quests.

Moontouched Den is a small wildkin enclave located in Darkshore, east of the Ruins of Auberdine. It contains a group of wildkin nests and fetishes. Once a thriving community of wildkin, the population was decimated following the Cataclysm. The den proper is a small cave whose sole occupant is Aroom, the last surviving wildkin in the area. The other wildkin here are crazed spirits. After the War of the Thorns, the Horde moved into Darkshore and the Bilgewater Cartel began a mining operation at Moontouched Den, just north of Aroom's cave.

.]] Moonwater Retreat is is located in southeast Jade Forest and is bordered by the Bamboo Wilds, the Den of Sorrow, Amberfly Bog and the Pearl Lake. The jinyu here have been slaughtered by the hozen. The jinyu lore object Watersmithing is found on the western side of the central pond of the retreat. Interacting it is a requirement of the Pandaria exploration achievement Fish Tales.

Mora Cliffhoof is a Highmountain tauren sitting in a hut slightly northwest of the lower level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain. She is having a conversation with Ferra Leafheart, Gala Woodbridge and A'te Amberfur about their children.
Morg Strongcurrent is a vision of Highmountain tauren located in Highmountain. He appears upon interacting with the Ancient Spirit Drum.
__NOTOC__ Moontalon is an owl located in the Tomb of Sargeras. It's the pet of Captain Yathae Moonstrike.

Mor'Bitan is a powerful lich from the House of Rituals who assisted in the destruction of the House of Eyes. He was later ordered by his house's new baron to personally oversee a ritual at the Rotting Mound that would apparently grant him more power as a reward for his destruction of the Eyes. Mor'Bitan sent his underlings, led by his lieutenant Mephiles, to harvest anima from the marsh of Glutharn's Decay in preparation for the ritual. During the Maldraxxus storyline, Baroness Vashj and other survivors from the House of Eyes seek vengeance against Mor'Bitan. After extracting information from Mephiles' memories, Vashj and the Maw Walker sabotage Mor'Bitan's ritual before luring him into the
Moonsong is a wildkin located in Verdant Wilds during Island Expeditions.
Moonshatter Breastplate is looted from Relinquished Chestguard.
Moonshatter Gauntlets are looted from Relinquished Gauntlets.
Moonthorn Branches would be used to create a Moonthorn Bundle.
Mortimer Montague is a Forsaken banker located in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. He was present during the Battle for Lordaeron and could be evacuated out of the Undercity.

Morthis Whisperwing is the start of the questline for the Druid Swift Flight Form. You need to have riding skill of 300 before you can receive this quest. Note that as of Patch 3.0.3 you no longer need to complete this quest to obtain Swift Flight Form, though completing this chain awards the achievement . You can learn this form from a druid trainer at level 71, after you have obtained a riding skill of 300.

A morningstar, or "morning star", is usually described as a studded, metal ball attached by a chain to a thick stick. Gladiators use these. King Gordok used one in the mak'gora challenge issued by Malus who bested his opponent and ended the ogre's life with the weapon.

Morshelz Copperpinch is a vendor located in the Bazaar section of Silvermoon City, near the bank, during the Feast of Winter Veil event. He is affiliated with Smokywood Pastures, and sells higher value holiday related items. His low value counterpart is
Mortal Wounds is a healing debuff shared by various different abilities. The following abilities apply a Mortal Wounds effect:

Morulu The Elder is a Broken master Pet Tamer in the Lower City of Shattrath City. He is surrounded by his three pet baby crocolisks, Cragmaw, Chomps, and Gnasher. Defeating him is required to complete the Taming Outland achievement.
Motega Laughingtotem is a Highmountain tauren located in Highmountain.

Mounts are a much sought-after form of transportation in which players ride atop the backs of various more or less exotic beasts (or machines). Warlocks, paladins, and death knights can learn to summon mounts as a class perk. Mounted travel is almost always faster than walking/running (amphibious mounts such as the Sea Turtle (mount) provide only circumstantial speed boosts on land). World of Warcraft: The Burning Crusade introduced flying mounts in select areas, which further increased the maximum possible player movement speed and also increased accessibility to various locations previously unreachable. Mountain Lions are mountain lions found in the Hillsbrad Foothills.

Mountaineer Pebblebitty is a dwarf located in the Valley of Kings in Loch Modan. She guards Stonewrought Pass, the tunnel to Searing Gorge. Prior to Cataclysm the tunnel was gated and required the Key to Searing Gorge to open. The key was given by Pebblebitty after a proof of strength. At some point, she fought with Margol the Rager. During the encounter, her axe got stuck in the beast's horn.

The Mountains of Flame are a mountain range in seen on the northern portion of the Outland map in Warcraft III: The Frozen Throne. As seen from the map, it is near where the Black Citadel was located.
Mountaineer Stormpike's Task is the 1st quest in the Mountaineer Stormpike's Task quest chain.
Mountaineer Dolf is an injured dwarf mountaineer who needs help just south of the town of Kharanos in Dun Morogh. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Mountaineer Hammerfall is a dwarf mountaineer found in Loch Modan. He is one of the guards at Algaz Station.
Mountaineer Brokk is a dwarf mountaineer found in Loch Modan. He patrols from Dun Algaz to Algaz Station.
Mountain dwarves is a term used for a sub-race of dwarves that live primarily in the mountains.
Mounted Ironforge Mountaineers are Ironforge Mountaineers mounted on rams seen patrolling the Ironforge Airfield in Dun Morogh and the unnamed farms in the Wetlands.
A Mountain Trout School is a fishing pool which primarily contains Mountain Trout. These schools can be found in the inland waters of Mount Hyjal.
Mountain Horse is the worgen racial mount (such as it is), and is sold for by the following vendors: * in Darnassus between the Cenarion Enclave and the Howling Oak or in Stormwind City
Mountaineer Dunstan is one of the three dwarven mountaineers assigned to observe the wendigos of Grizzled Den in Dun Morogh. He is the leader of the three.

Mountaineer Falmor is a dwarf located at the Ironforge Airfield in Dun Morogh during Legion Invasions. He seems to lead the few Dun Morogh Mountaineers who survived the demonic assault.

Mountainfoot Grunts are orcish grunts protecting the Mountainfoot Strip Mine in Azshara. During the Legion Invasions, they could be found injured or being cornered by demons. Saving them would improve the score of defense against the Legion.

Mountainfoot Miners are goblin miners of the Bilgewater Cartel employed by Horzak Zignibble to work in the Mountainfoot Strip Mine‎ of Azshara, where they are in danger of being turned to stone by basilisks. Horzak pondered the possibilty of selling the stonified miners, but comes to the conclusion that in the end the poor quality stone would get him less money than re-fleshifying his employees to do their normal job.
Mountain Puffer can be fished from Highmountain in open water while under the effect of the Swollen Murloc Egg.
Mountains Will Fall is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Mountain Colossi were colossi located at Skettis in Terokkar Forest. At low health, Mountain Shardlings would split off from the colossus.
Mountain Shardlings were colossi located at Skettis in Terokkar Forest. When Mountain Colossi became wounded, these shardlings would split off.
__NOTOC__ Muffin Man Moser is a human bread vendor located in the Lower City in Shattrath City. He's got muffins!

An unnamed cave can be found in the northeast corner of Mulgore, near the top of the mountain, while taking the flight path between Orgrimmar and Thunder Bluff. This area consists of a tauren hut and a cave, both of which were completely empty. As of Battle for Azeroth, the hut was taken over by Verd Twiceswindle and Venture Lackeys.
Muffin is a wolf and is the pet of Joan Tremblay. The wolf is located in the Hall of the Crescent Moon of the Shrine of Two Moons. It is also found in the kennel of Orgrimmar.

The Muisek is the avenging spirit of a creature killed in a violent death. With a specially made vessel the Muisek of a creature can be captured and used for a powerful spirit weapon or whatever else the enchanter wishes. The Muisek, during the capture process can be prevented from escaping if the creature is shrunken first. Witch Doctor Uzer'i hopes to use the power of captured Muisek so that he may allow those spirits to aid the Horde.
Mucksnout Den is a cave that passes through a small mountain in Highmountain.

The Mrgrggrgl Mark III is a unique destroyer crewed by murlocs. Each Destroyer built at the Lunarfall and Frostwall Shipyards has a ~5% chance to be this ship, and as such the murlocs can serve both the Alliance and Horde.

Muirn Ironhorn is a Highmountain tauren blacksmith located in Ironhorn Enclave in Highmountain. He is seen hammering on the Fimament Stone, over which he maintains vigil. In secret, he keeps a few helm patterns around, mainly for amusement and decoration.
Mummified Magics is a pet battle achievement earned by defeating 9 Master Tamers in the Shadowlands with a team of all level 25 Magic pets.

__NOTOC__ Muran Fairden is a night elf druid trainer located in the Silver Enclave in the mage city of Dalaran. He was previously located in the Underbelly. He was present in the city when it relocated above Deadwind Pass but did not offer his training services as he had to remain alert for any danger to Dalaran's citizens and visitors.

Muninn is a raven located in Stormheim. Huginn and Muninn once had a jewel called the Raven's Eye, created for them by Havi, that allowed them to read and understand any language. Kur'talos Ravencrest tricked them into giving it to him in exchange for candy. Upon placing the Aegis of Aggramar, he briefly appears flying in the Portrait Room in Dalaran. He also appears in Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore.

Murkloc Tadpoles are juvenile murlocs of the Murkloc tribe found inside the Murkloc Cave in Highmountain after completing Oh, the Clawdacity!. They are the result of Murky recruiting a number of Swamprock Tadpoles to his cause.

Murrl is a murloc from a fishing village in the Forgotten Coast in Feralas. She has a husband named Murrgly and a nephew Murky. Murrl, Murrgly and several other murlocs were captured by the Gordunni clan and brought to Dire Maul to fight for the ogre's amusement. When Aramar Thorne was brought there, the family was briefly reunited with Murky who rescued them from being recaptured by Wordok. Their nephew decided to join Aram and leave. The murlocs escaped from the ruined city, assisted by Woolbeard and an ogre girl.

Muzzlecrank was a goblin bruiser in the port city of Ratchet. Three years after the Battle of Mount Hyjal, tensions flared up between the Horde and Theramore because of the incident on the Orgath'ar merchant ship. __NOTOC__ Myre Moonglide is a night elf flight master located at Stardust Spire in Ashenvale.

Players who interact with the Mysterious Camel Figurine, a critter-sized, name-plated statuette which can spawn randomly all over Uldum, have a chance of being teleported to the Steam Pools. They are then debuffed with a tracking debuff that gives them 20 minutes to find and kill Dormus. Anyone who kills him gets an epic ground mount, the Reins of the Grey Riding Camel. There are actually two different kinds of figurine: I.D. 50409 and I.D. 50410. The first kind are the rare ones, that will teleport you to the Steam Pools. The second, more common kind will only turn into Crumbled Statue Remnants, vendor trash worth 25 gold.

She can later be found at Duskhaven in Gilneas and finally at the Howling Oak in Darnassus. During the Burning of Teldrassil, she was seemingly evacuated with the civilians to Stormwind City.

Right after the Battle for the Broken Shore, Dalaran was hovering over Deadwind Pass and more particularly Karazhan. The entire city had been moved by a giant :Blink spell. Some Dalaran Citizens were now suffering of dizziness and nausea, while others were re-materialized at the wrong place and were stuck in walls or in various other objects. Muun Windchest is a Highmountain tauren found on a wooden balcony halfway down the cliffside southwest of Thunder Totem in Highmountain, butting heads with Hanye Chargefeather.

Myra Cabot is a human located at Big Mountain Mining Supply Co. in the Tradewinds Market in Boralus. According to Boralus' guards, Myra has a preternatural ability to sniff out a vein. She can teach the latest mining techniques.
From her humble beginnings in Silvermoon to the depths of Blackrock Mountain, Muze always remained steadfast, faithfully healing her companions and saving them from the brinks of death.

A mystic is a loosely-defined class among many races. The majority of mystics use shamanistic magics, although others use nature, arcane or shadow spells. However, most use magic from only one such school. Windsages of Clan Ohn'ir in the Ohn'ahran Plains on the Dragon Isles are mystics.

Myths of the Dragonflight Dungeons is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by completing each of the Dragonflight dungeons on Mythic or Mythic Keystone difficulty.

Naga Summoners are naga who Illidan made ethereal to better protect them, when they were continuing the spell Illidan cast using the Eye of Sargeras to destroy the Frozen Throne. They were killed and the Eye was destroyed by the combined forces of Maiev, Malfurion, and Magroth the Defender.

Nacea Shorewalker is a Highmountain tauren located in Highmountain.

Nailor was a member of the crew on the Bold Arva commanded by Flynn Fairwind that aided Mathias Shaw in his mission to check the costs of Zandalar for signs that the Banshee loyalists were on the continent. He was stationed in the crow's nest.

Nah'qi is a large and powerful fire somnowl found flying hundreds of meters above ground around Amirdrassil in the central Emerald Dream. She is the second spirit beast to modeled after an owl, and the only spirit beast to require a Cinder of Companionship.
__NOTOC__ Narinth is a blood elf portal trainer located in Sunfury Spire in Silvermoon City.

Nature's Swiftness is a Restoration druid ability. This ability, when activated, causes the next Entangling Roots, Healing Touch, Rebirth, or Regrowth to be instant, heal more, and have a longer duration. For example, activating Nature's Swiftness and then casting Healing Touch will instantly cast a heal without that spell's normal 2.5 second casting time, and increase the amount healed by 50%. Nature's Swiftness does not affect channeled spells.

__NOTOC__ Naseev is a high elf warrior trainer located in the Silver Enclave in the mage city of Dalaran. He was present in the city when it relocated above Deadwind Pass but did not offer his training services as he had to remain alert for any danger to Dalaran's visitors.

__NOTOC__ Nastrondir is mountain in northern Stormheim, and the nesting grounds for the brood of Nithogg, who came here after the Thorignir swore fealty to the Keepers. The dragons here terrorize the nearby lands. The statue of Nashal the Watcher is located in the cliffs of the mountain.
Nata Windchaser is a Highmountain tauren general goods vendor found in the Tradewind Roost at Skyhorn in Highmountain.

Navane was a planet inhabited by a handful of intelligent races. Though they shared a history of enmity, they put aside their differences to form a tenuous alliance when the demons of the Burning Legion invaded their world. During this time, the dreadlord Kathra'natir came into possession of the dreaded blade known as Apocalypse. Disguised as one of their own soldiers, Kathra'natir walked among Navane's resistance forces and whispered rumors of betrayal in every ear while Apocalypse clouded the defenders' ability to reason. Nazaruul is a Scourge necromancer, his stronghold is in the Plaguelands. He is a troll who tried to engineer a new war between humanity and orcs by driving various orcs and humans so mad with hatred in hopes that the truce collapses. He did this by inserting dreams in their minds, which were seen as prophetic visions. One such victim was the ex-paladin Aretain Naris, who thought he lost his paladin powers so that the Light could give him prophetic powers in their place. His plans were discovered by a group of heroes, and he was stopped.
Naznik Sureshave is the goblin in charge of the Barbershop in the Trade Quarter in the Undercity. He was present during the city's evacuation during the Battle for Lordaeron.

Nazj'vel is located far south off the coast of the Twilight Shore in Darkshore and is home to the naga. :Azerite began to crop up all over the island around the same time as the Burning of Teldrassil. During the Battle for Darkshore when the Alliance controls the zone, Nazj'vel is taken by Bilgewater goblins who use their machinery to mine Azerite. The entrance to the cave has been collapsed, but a pile of explosives is found in front of the rubble, indicating that the goblins intend to re-enter it. When the Horde is in control of Darkshore, Nazj'vel is taken by Gilnean worgen who destroyed the goblins' machinery. Adventurers are sent here to defeat enemy factions.

The Necrodark drogbar are the servants of Uul'gyneth the Darkness in Highmountain. They existed as far as the times of Huln Highmountain who battled them. Following the end of the Burning Legion's third invasion, they resurfaced and summoned Uul'gyneth but were defeated.
Nazmani Skyterrors are pterrordax flying over the Shattered River, Rivermarsh, and Primal Wetlands in Nazmir and Zuldazar.

The warlike necrolords of Maldraxxus, also called the Maldraxxi, are one of the Covenants in the Shadowlands. They forge the undead armies that serve as the first line of defense for the Shadowlands and honor those who seek power and glory in battle. All Necrolords receive a portion of the Primus' power in order to carry out their duty. Warlike souls who never yield or bow—and are willing to strive against one another for greatness—will find a home in Maldraxxus. While Maldraxxus is home to wicked beings like necromancers and abominations, not everyone here is evil. The Necrolords welcome all who are mighty and driven, such as the indomitable Warlord Draka. Class leaders ventured inside to recover the Hammer of Khaz'goroth stolen by Dargrul the Underking. The entrance is at Snowblind Mesa - a short walk East up the hill from the cliffs behind Thunder Totem. The dragon-sized entrance is Neltharion's Vault. A Necrotic Altar can be found at the Darkmaul Plains on Exile's Reach. Filled with foul magic, it projects a around itself that instantly kills anyone who tries to pass through. Yorah and Daelya Twilightsbane's final task on the mortal plane is to help a young paladin destroy the altar. __NOTOC__

Nestlewood Hills is an area in southern Ammen Vale, filled with owlkin. The only ways to reach this area are by going through the Nestlewood Thicket or following the mountain path. The owlkin have gathered the scattered Emitter Spare Parts here and in the Nestlewood Thicket (see Spare Parts (Azuremyst Isle)). Unfortunately, some of the native owlkin have been mutated by the radiation from the power crystals that fell from the draenei ship the Exodar, and have become hostile to travelers. Some draenei are attempting to inoculate the unaffected owlkin using an Inoculating Crystal to keep them from being mutated like their fellow friends (see Inoculation). .]] Nerubian flyers are nerubian spider-creatures that have developed membranes or laid webbing between their legs, similar to a bat's wing, allowing them to fly. Nether Attunement is a passive Mage ability that turns spell haste into mana regeneration as well as increasing mana gains from mage spells such as Evocation.

Only the top-level spawning version attacks unprovoked. During the Iron Horde Incursion, they were executed.

Nether-Weather Vane is provided as an objective for Test Flight: Ruuan Weald. It will turn into a Spinning Nether-Weather Vane when spun on the flight to Ruuan Weald.

Neophyte Combatants are draenei located at Aldor Rise in Shattrath City. They are found in the tunnel leading up to the High Path in Nagrand. Since the launching of the Battle for Quel'Danas they wear Shattered Sun Offensive tabards.

Its storyline can be roughly divided into three parts - helping the B.O.O.M. at Area 52, helping the Consortium, and helping the mages trapped in Kirin'Var Village. New Stromgarde was the city where Trant and Haneth met for the first time. Little is known about the city as it only received one off-hand reference.

New Kargath, built atop Apocryphan's Rest near the shattered Ruins of Kargath, is the new Horde bastion within the Badlands, erected after the Cataclysm. It is a full-fledged town and appears to be under constant attack by members of the Black dragonflight, and its blacksmith is occupied by them. The town is equipped with several catapults and blade throwers.

New Tinkertown is a small town built just outside of Gnomeregan. It is here that the surviving gnomes teleport to after having escaped their radiated city after the Cataclysm. It was presumably named after the Tinker Town gnomish district of Ironforge.
New Strength is Tormmok's quest to unlock an additional ability once you gain Trusted Bodyguard status with him.
Netherwhelp Online is a feat of strength achievement earned by being the proud owner of the Moon-Touched Netherwhelp from BlizzConline.

Nick Arse is a Forsaken vendor located in front of the Cauldron of Rock cave on the Darkmoon Island.

__NOTOC__ Niana Moontear is a night elf located at Rut'theran Village in Teldrassil. Since The Bravery is out of commission, she created a mage portal to Stormwind City to compensate. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Nightborne Battlemages are nightborne located in the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar during the battle at the Gates of Orgrimmar. On Varok Saurfang's orders, they teleported to cover the rebellion's flank and were tasked with shielding the army against magical assault.
